sam: Quick thread — scenario: tenant with EU residency pinned to eu-west, but we get a spike in us-west and our routing falls back. what's the minimal safety contract for writes so we don't violate residency?
maya: short answer: never write PII out of eu without explicit consent flags. but can we make reads/async writes safe?
dmitri: thinking aloud — allow a proxy-ack for initial write, store in escrow queue in the fallback region, and forward to eu primary async. return 202 to client.
sam: can we rely on async queue for all customers? some customers need sync durability guarantees (billing, order ids).
maya: for those we should enforce region-bound routing (reject w/ 409 or 451). i don't want to silently escrow billing events.
ana: +1 to dual-mode: sync-failfast vs async-escrow. customers opt into async with a header.
sam: proposal sketch: if header `X-Residency-Mode: async-escrow` present -> accept 202 then mirror; else if tenant policy==EU-only -> block unless routed to eu-primary.
dmitri: pseudo check: ```if tenant.residency=="eu" and region!="eu-west" and header!="async-escrow": return 451```
maya: add a short TTL on escrow and an auditing tag so ops can reconcile. also record original request id for idempotency.
ana: ops runbook note: when eu-primary is unreachable, escalate to oncall and enable temporary global-readonly for affected tenants so we don't accept writes.
ops-bot: Incident detector: eu-west unhealthy 2023-11-12T03:12Z — flagging tenants with residency=eu with fallback writes disabled.
sam: how to surface to customers? header + webhook callback when escrow replay completes?
dmitri: yes webhook + optional synchronous status endpoint `/escrow/{id}`. clients can poll.
maya: edge case: replay fails due to schema mismatch on eu side (old model). must surface failure and not drop data. use quarantine bucket and alert.
sam: agree. we should make SDKs surface 451 vs 202 clearly and provide migration docs.
nana: docs TODO: small diagram, TTL semantics, webhook payload shape, operator checklist.
sam: action items: 1) write short RFC for "escrow proxy" with header contract and error codes. 2) ops: add runbook snippet for enabling global-readonly + alerts. 3) eng-runtime: implement escrow queue + idempotency keys.
maya: ping @dmitri for proto, i'll craft the user-facing messaging. :+1:
ops-bot: Created task INF-3421 "escrow-proxy rfc" assigned to dmitri — due 2023-11-19.
